provenance.note: The five matches of D.10A.12 add up to 150 shots (24, 18, 24, 24 and 60), the book prints no total. The 50 m parts may be shot at 25 m on the face "BDMP 1500 .30M1 reduziert", for which the book prints no dimensions and no record exists.
